design_rationale: The study is described as a multicenter, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, parallel-group trial.

domain_judgments.rationale: The study was randomized and stratified, and baseline characteristics were balanced across groups, but details regarding sequence generation and allocation concealment were not explicitly reported.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: On day 1, patients were randomized in a double-blind manner to either placebo, dapagliflozin 5-mg, or dapagliflozin 10-mg daily, in addition to their original pre-enrollment antidiabetic regimen. Randomization was stratified based on pre-enrollment antihyperglycemic therapy...

domain_judgments.rationale: The trial was double-blinded, placebo-controlled, and utilized an intention-to-treat approach using ANCOVA with LOCF with no evidence of non-protocol deviations biasing the results.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: This multicenter, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, parallel-group, phase 2/3 study took place in 111 sites... The primary efficacy analysis was based on an analysis of covariance model with treatment group and pre-enrollment antihyperglycemic therapy stratum as fixed effects and the baseline value as a covariate.

domain_judgments.rationale: Outcome data for the primary endpoint at week 24 were available for nearly all randomized participants (247 of 252, >98%).
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The primary end point (HbA1c) was assessed at 24 weeks using ANCOVA with LOCF excluding data after rescue, with 82/84 (placebo), 83/83 (5 mg), and 82/85 (10 mg) randomized patients having non-missing baseline and week 24 (LOCF) values.

domain_judgments.rationale: HbA1c was measured objectively by an automated central laboratory using high-performance liquid chromatography in a double-blind trial.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: A central laboratory evaluated the assays for the efficacy and safety outcomes, using high-performance liquid chromatography for HbA1c and colorimetric indicator for plasma creatinine and urinary albumin:creatinine ratio.

domain_judgments.rationale: The study was registered at ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT00663260) and reports the pre-specified primary and secondary outcomes and analyses.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: This Bristol-Myers Squibb and AstraZeneca-supported study is also known as Study MB102029 and is registered with ClinicalTrials.gov, number NCT00663260, available at http://clinicaltrials.gov.

overall_summary: The trial has some concerns overall due to lack of explicit information regarding the random sequence generation and allocation concealment methods in Domain 1, despite being low risk across all other domains.

design_rationale: Participants were randomly assigned (1:1) to dapagliflozin 10 mg or matching placebo using an interactive voice/web response system (IVRS/IWRS).

domain_judgments.rationale: Randomization was conducted using a centralized IVRS/IWRS with adequate allocation concealment, and baseline characteristics were well balanced between groups.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Eligible patients were assigned a unique randomization code using an interactive voice response system (IVRS) or interactive web response system (IWRS). For each randomized patient the IVRS/IWRS provided the investigator with a unique Kit ID number matching the treatment arm assigned to the patient.

domain_judgments.rationale: Participants and investigators were blinded with matching placebo, rescue medication rules were standardized, and analyses adhered to modified intention-to-treat principles.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: This was a randomized, double-blind, two-arm, parallel group, placebo-controlled, multinational, Phase 3 study... Patients were randomized (1:1) to 24 weeks of treatment with dapagliflozin 10 mg or matching placebo.

domain_judgments.rationale: Completion rates were high and balanced between groups (>90% completed double-blind treatment), and an appropriate mixed-effects model for repeated measures (MMRM) was used for missing data.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Most patients completed the study, regardless of double-blind treatment discontinuation (156 patients [97.5%] in the dapagliflozin group and 154 patients [95.7%] in the placebo group) and most also completed the 24-week double-blind treatment period (149 patients [93.1%] in the dapagliflozin group and 146 patients [90.7%] in the placebo group).

domain_judgments.rationale: HbA1c was measured via standard objective laboratory assays with trial participants and personnel fully blinded to intervention allocation.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The primary efficacy outcome was mean change from baseline in HbA1c at Week 24.

domain_judgments.rationale: The study protocol and statistical analysis plan were pre-specified and registered on ClinicalTrials.gov, and all planned primary and secondary efficacy outcomes were reported as specified.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The study was conducted in accordance with the Declaration of Helsinki and Good Clinical Practice Guidelines... This study is registered on ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT02413398). The study protocol is available online: http://astrazenecagrouptrials.pharmacm.com.

overall_summary: The study is a well-designed, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial with central allocation concealment, high completion rates, objective outcome measurements, and pre-specified analyses, resulting in a low risk of bias across all RoB 2 domains.

design_rationale: The study is explicitly described as a phase 3, multicenter, multinational, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial with 1:1 random assignment via a central interactive web response system.

domain_judgments.rationale: Randomization and allocation concealment were achieved through a central interactive web response system with appropriate stratification, and baseline characteristics were well-balanced between groups.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: After run-in, eligible patients were randomly assigned in a 1:1 ratio to receive bexagliflozin (20 mg) or placebo for 24 weeks in an outpatient setting, with a final study visit at week 26. Randomization was stratified by screening HbA1c level... Randomization and study drug allocation were performed through a central interactive web response system.

domain_judgments.rationale: Participants and investigators were fully blinded using identical placebo, rescue therapy was protocol-specified and handled via predefined statistical methods, and an intention-to-treat approach was used.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Investigators, patients, and the sponsor team remained blinded to allocation groups for the duration of the trial. Allocation codes were maintained by a designated statistician not involved in study operations... Effectiveness analyses were performed in an intention-to-treat manner.

domain_judgments.rationale: Retention was high in both arms (>96% in the intervention group and >92% in the placebo group), and mixed-effects repeated-measures models were used to account for missingness.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: A total of 312 patients (157 in the bexagliflozin arm and 155 in the placebo arm) were included in the final analysis (Fig 1)... Study Completed N=152; 96.8% [bexagliflozin] ... Study Completed N=144; 92.9% [placebo].

domain_judgments.rationale: The primary outcome (HbA1c change) is an objective laboratory measurement processed by central facilities, and double-blinding prevented differential assessment between groups.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Samples for laboratory testing were processed at regional central facilities... Investigators, patients, and the sponsor team remained blinded to allocation groups for the duration of the trial.

domain_judgments.rationale: The trial was prospectively registered (NCT02836873) with a predefined statistical analysis plan, and reported outcomes align with the pre-specified primary and secondary endpoints.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The study protocol and statistical analysis plan were developed by the Massachusetts General Hospital Translational Medicine Group. The trial was registered with ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT02836873)... The primary outcome of change in percent HbA1c level from baseline to week 24 was analyzed using a mixed-effect model repeated-measures analysis of covariance (ANCOVA)...

overall_summary: The study is a well-designed, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial with central web-based randomization, low attrition, objective centrally assessed laboratory outcomes, and adherence to a prespecified statistical analysis plan. Across all five RoB 2 domains, risk of bias is low, resulting in an overall low risk of bias judgment.

design_rationale: The trial explicitly reports that participants were randomly assigned in a 1:1 ratio using randomly permuted blocks to receive either canagliflozin or matching placebo.

domain_judgments.rationale: Allocation used stratified randomly permuted blocks with matching placebo, and baseline characteristics were well-balanced between groups.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The patients were randomly assigned in a double-blind fashion (1:1) to receive either canagliflozin (100 mg orally once daily) or matching placebo with the use of randomly permuted blocks, with stratification according to the category of estimated GFR... at screening.

domain_judgments.rationale: The study was double-blind with matching placebo, and primary efficacy analyses were conducted according to the intention-to-treat principle.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: In the intention-to-treat population, we used a stratified Cox proportional-hazards model to analyze the primary and secondary outcomes, according to the category of estimated GFR at screening.

domain_judgments.rationale: Follow-up for outcomes was nearly complete (vital status ascertained for 99.9% of participants), and sensitivity analyses with imputation produced virtually identical results.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: A total of 4361 patients (99.1%) were either alive with follow-up at the end of the trial or had died before the final follow-up visit. Consent was withdrawn by 16 patients (0.4%), and vital status was ascertained for all but 6 patients (4395 [99.9%]).

domain_judgments.rationale: Primary and secondary outcomes were assessed through objective laboratory criteria and verified by blinded independent adjudication committees.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: All renal and cardiovascular outcomes that were part of the primary and secondary outcomes, as well as key safety outcomes (fractures, pancreatitis, ketoacidosis, and renal-cell carcinoma), were adjudicated by independent adjudication committees whose members were unaware of trial-group assignments.

domain_judgments.rationale: The trial had a pre-registered protocol (ClinicalTrials.gov NCT02065791) with prespecified hierarchical testing and formal stopping rules for early cessation, adhering to the plan without evidence of selective outcome reporting.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The trial was designed to be event-driven... A single interim analysis was to be conducted by an independent data monitoring committee after the primary outcome had occurred in 405 patients. Prespecified stopping guidance that was provided to the data monitoring committee by the steering committee proposed possible recommendation of early cessation if clear evidence of benefit was observed... Secondary outcomes that were planned for sequential hierarchical testing were specified in the following order...

overall_summary: The trial is a rigorously conducted, double-blind randomized controlled trial with central adjudication, high retention, prespecified statistical hierarchical testing, and intention-to-treat analyses. All five RoB 2 domains were assessed as having a low risk of bias.

design_rationale: The study is a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled clinical trial where participants were assigned to dapagliflozin or matching placebo using an interactive voice- or web-response system with balanced blocks.

domain_judgments.rationale: Randomization sequence generation and allocation concealment were robustly implemented using an interactive voice-response or web-response system, and baseline characteristics were well balanced between groups.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Participants were randomly assigned to receive dapagliflozin (10 mg once daily) or matching placebo, in accordance with the sequestered, fixed-randomization schedule, with the use of balanced blocks to ensure an approximate 1:1 ratio of the two regimens... Investigators used an interactive voice-response or Web-response system to determine trial-group assignments.

domain_judgments.rationale: Double-blind placebo-controlled design with identical packaging was maintained, and primary analyses were conducted according to the intention-to-treat principle.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Participants and all trial personnel (except the members of the independent data monitoring committee) were unaware of the trial-group assignments. Dapagliflozin and placebo were packaged identically, with uniform tablet appearance, labeling, and administration schedules... The primary efficacy analysis was based on the intention-to-treat population, which included all the participants who had undergone randomization.

domain_judgments.rationale: Follow-up was virtually complete with 99.7% completing the trial and vital status ascertained for all but 5 participants (0.1%).
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: In all, 4289 participants (99.7%) completed the trial (i.e., were alive with follow-up data available at the trial completion visit or had died during follow-up). A total of 11 participants (0.3%) withdrew consent, and vital status was ascertained for all but 5 participants (0.1%).

domain_judgments.rationale: Outcomes were objective or adjudicated by an independent committee blinded to treatment assignment, and laboratory-based outcomes were measured centrally.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: An independent committee whose members were unaware of the trial-group assignments adjudicated all primary and secondary outcomes, except for a sustained decline in the estimated GFR of at least 50% and a sustained estimated GFR of less than 15 ml per minute per 1.73 m², which were ascertained from central laboratory measurements.

domain_judgments.rationale: The trial was preregistered (NCT03036150) with a prespecified statistical analysis plan and hierarchical testing strategy, and results are reported in accordance with the protocol.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The analytical approach and power calculations have been published previously, and the complete prespecified statistical analysis plan is available with the protocol at NEJM.org... A closed testing procedure that included a prespecified hierarchical order of the primary and secondary outcomes was used to ensure control of type I error at a two-sided 0.05 level.

overall_summary: The trial was well conducted with low risk of bias across all five RoB 2 domains, featuring robust centralized randomization, double blinding, virtually complete follow-up (>99.9% vital status ascertainment), blinded outcome adjudication, and adherence to a prespecified statistical analysis plan.

design_rationale: Participants were randomly assigned to empagliflozin or matching placebo using a minimization process with a 10% stochastic element.

domain_judgments.rationale: The allocation sequence was generated using a central minimization algorithm with a random component, and baseline characteristics were well-balanced between groups.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Patients were randomly assigned to receive empagliflozin (10 mg once daily) or matching placebo. Randomization was performed with the use of a minimization process with a 10% stochastic element.

domain_judgments.rationale: The study was double-blind with matching placebo, adherence was high, and analysis was performed according to the intention-to-treat principle.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: All the analyses were performed according to the intention-to-treat principle and included data from all patients who had undergone randomization, including data collected from the time of the formal interim analysis to the final follow-up visits.

domain_judgments.rationale: Outcome data were available for 99.1% of randomized participants, with minimal and balanced loss to follow-up.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: In total, 6552 patients (99.1%) were alive and completed final follow-up or had died during follow-up. Vital status was missing for 18 patients (0.3%), and 39 patients (0.6%) withdrew consent.

domain_judgments.rationale: Outcomes were objective clinical endpoints or adjudicated by an independent committee masked to trial-group allocation using prespecified definitions.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: All events of death, potential hospitalizations for heart failure, myocardial infarction, stroke, liver injury, ketoacidosis, lower-limb amputation, acute kidney injury, and serious genital infections were adjudicated by clinicians who were unaware of trial-group assignments, with the use of prespecified definitions and source documents collected from trial sites.

domain_judgments.rationale: The trial followed a prespecified, publicly registered protocol and statistical analysis plan with appropriate multiplicity adjustments.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The protocol and the full statistical analysis plan are available at www.empakidney.org... All the analyses were performed according to the intention-to-treat principle... The key secondary outcomes were prespecified to be adjusted for multiple testing with the use of the Hochberg step-up procedure, with a familywise error rate of 0.029.
